news.title: Shippers' backup plan is getting more expensive
news.summary: When primary truckload carriers turn down freight, the backup carriers that step in are now charging noticeably more, and that gap is widening into Thanksgiving week.
news.why: Shippers should price tender-rejection risk into routing guides and contract talks rather than treating backup capacity as a free safety net.

news.title: Geodis: U.S. Q3 delivery costs rose three times faster than inflation
news.summary: Geodis' final-mile index shows U.S. delivery costs climbed about 10.5% year over year in the third quarter, roughly triple the pace of consumer inflation.
news.why: Shippers should budget for higher last-mile rates into 2027 and consider consolidating orders or renegotiating zones to offset the increase.

news.title: FedEx and three finance firms complete $8.5 billion buyout of Polish parcel company
news.summary: A consortium that includes FedEx has closed its $8.5 billion purchase of InPost, taking the Polish parcel-locker network private.
news.why: Cross-border e-commerce sellers into Europe may gain tighter FedEx–locker integration, but should watch for pricing changes under new ownership.

news.title: Two Tanker Incidents Reported Near Oman; Vessel Hit Mine East Of Hormuz
news.summary: Two more tankers ran into trouble around the Strait of Hormuz, one struck by an unidentified projectile off Oman and another reportedly damaged by a mine east of the strait.
news.why: Repeated strikes keep war-risk insurance and Gulf tanker rates elevated, which feeds through to fuel, resin and chemical input costs.

news.title: Watchmen at LA, Long Beach Ports Agree to Tentative Labor Deal
news.summary: The security watchmen's union at the Los Angeles and Long Beach ports reached a tentative contract with the Pacific Maritime Association, heading off a strike, though members still have to ratify it.
news.why: The biggest near-term threat to peak-season flow through the main U.S. import gateway has eased, so importers can drop contingency diversions unless ratification stalls.

news.title: Nike Sneakers, Milwaukee Tools Among $22.5M Haul in 'Staggering' Train Heist
news.summary: Prosecutors charged 14 people accused of looting more than $22.5 million in goods from at least 36 Southern California freight trains over two and a half years, allegedly by forcing emergency stops.
news.why: Shippers of high-value consumer goods on intermodal rail should review cargo insurance limits, seal and tracking practices, and which lanes carry their most theft-prone SKUs.

news.title: Big Grocers Offer Loss-Leading Deals on Thanksgiving Dinner
news.summary: Walmart, Aldi, Amazon and Hy-Vee are selling discounted Thanksgiving meal bundles priced well below the Farm Bureau's estimated $58.63 cost of a 10-person dinner, which is up about 6% from last year.
news.why: Food suppliers should expect retailers to lean on them for promotional funding while input costs stay elevated, squeezing vendor margins through the holidays.

news.title: Trump Says U.S. to Penalize Firms Building Data Centers Abroad
news.summary: The president said U.S. companies that build data centers overseas will face a large tax penalty, days after Commerce tightened AI chip exports to several Southeast Asian countries.
news.why: Buyers of servers, power and cooling gear should expect more U.S.-sited demand and tighter domestic lead times if the penalty becomes policy.

news.title: How Old Material-Handling Equipment Is Exposing Warehouses to Cyber Risk
news.summary: A feature explains how conveyors, sorters and other aging warehouse machines often run unsupported software that opens attack paths, noting few operators have even a complete inventory of such assets.
news.why: Shippers outsourcing to 3PLs should add operational-technology security questions to vendor audits, since a breached warehouse can halt their order flow.

news.title: Lufthansa Cargo to buy out 2nd ground agent at Frankfurt airport
news.summary: Lufthansa Cargo agreed to take over Fiege Air Cargo's handling operations at Frankfurt, pending regulatory approval, bringing more of its hub's cargo handling in-house.
news.why: Forwarders routing airfreight through Frankfurt may see changes in handling rates and service terms as the carrier consolidates control of its main hub.

news.title: Suspected Drone Attack Caused Explosion On Russian Ship At Benghazi Port
news.summary: Libyan authorities in the east said early findings link an explosion at Benghazi's naval base to a Russian vessel docked there, possibly hit by a drone.
news.why: Attacks on ships are spreading into the Mediterranean, adding to the war-risk premiums and routing uncertainty already weighing on ocean freight costs.
